name: zcode-writing-viewer
description: ZCode plugin for writing-anything workspaces (.writing-anything/): read-only overview dashboard, unit tree, artifact semantic-card and source-highlight views, sources list, plus MCP-held review sessions that proxy the wa-cli reading view for unit review.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsdown && node scripts/normalize-outputs.mjs && node scripts/stage-skills.mjs
